answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making standing something an identity earns inside the network, never purchased outside it. A newcomer starts at a bare vertex: nothing is granted, so it must submit real work and collect countersignatures from established peers before its votes carry weight. Reputation becomes a sonnet the ledger can verify, written line by attested line with a quill that only honest labor sharpens, while a thousand fresh keys are an empty echo with no verse of their own. Each agent climbs a ledge of its own making.
